name: Huntsville
housing: Huntsville's rentals are mostly newer apartment complexes and single-family houses, many rented by engineers and defense workers who move to the city for jobs.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Services Alabama
tenantHelp.what: free civil legal help for low-income renters, including evictions and repairs

climate: Test the air conditioning or heat pump and check windows and roofs for storm damage; the area has humid summers and frequent spring tornado warnings.
fact: Redstone Arsenal and the aerospace companies around it bring a steady stream of renters who move to Huntsville for work.
